d: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in the wake of revelations that he has had multiple affairs, one of which was with a suspected Chinese spy. Nvidia CFO Colette Kress has taken over as interim CEO, as the company looks for Huang's successor. US President Donald Trump says that Nvidia should replace Huang with former Apple CEO Tim Cook. Firstpost looks at the sequence of events that led to Huang's downfall. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the current situation at Nvidia, including the state of the firm's share prices. HKS also looks at the reaction from Elon Musk and others.
